title: Generate the source manifest at merge instead of in each pull request
summary: A pull request no longer commits a source manifest or edits CURRENT_MANIFEST, so parallel pull requests stop conflicting on that pointer and on stale hashes of shared files. `check_pipeline_lineages.py current` hashes the tree and reports its manifest digest; with --manifest it compares the tree or a mirror without Git metadata against a named manifest. CI fetches the archived Stage 2 commit and runs `generate` for every revision, and it keeps the manifest of each push to main as a workflow artifact. Published manifests keep their bytes.
next: Open pull requests that still add a manifest or change CURRENT_MANIFEST drop those edits when they merge after this change.
reason: The change moves manifest generation into CI; no roadmap marker, recorded fact, gate or published manifest changes.
